representation_fit.evidence: Brief asks for ONE high-consequence workflow completed zero-mistake; app is exactly that: a 12-step/4-phase cutover runbook (source/js/data.js:8-297) in a wizard layout with enforced sequence (source/js/app.js:127-131). Shape bundle matches: 基数 one, 层级性 high (阶段一~四), 密度 low (one execution card at a time), 比较需求 none (no comparison UI). Screenshots 1280x860/1440x900 show the workflow as the sole object.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen's dominant element is the current-step execution card ending in the large primary button 「确认完成本步骤」 (screenshots/1280x860.png center; app.js:408-416); header progress '0/12 步' frames the complete-the-whole-flow job (index.html:26-29); left nav exposes the full step map. No competing task exists.

time_to_understand.evidence: Document title states domain+goal (index.html:6 「零失误执行」); header shows CHG-2026-0912, 生产环境·PAY-PROD·变更窗口 (screenshot top bar); S1 opens at load with a one-line goal (data.js:20-25) and numbered instructions. What/where is conveyed within seconds; phases labeled in nav (app.js:331).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (current step + whole-flow map) is on screen at load: zero navigation steps. Any unlocked step reachable in one click via nav buttons (app.js:338-342); locked-step clicks are guard-intercepted by design (app.js:127-131) — enforcement of the zero-mistake job, not hidden navigation.

context_loss.evidence: Single page, no routing; one shared selection across nav/detail/inspector (app.js:13-22); confirm/recovery are modal overlays over the same screen (app.js:512-545); after executing a step the app auto-selects the next step (app.js:170-174) preserving position; execution log persists across actions (app.js:99-101); Escape cancels modals without state loss (app.js:611-614).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = header + 3 columns (index.html:35-42): flow map / execution card / risk-recovery inspector + audit log — each maps to a job need (orient, execute, recover, prove). Guard chip, restart, 导出/复制 all functional (app.js:313-317, 248-258, 261-301); no decorative controls found in source.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4/7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Source corroborates causes: native checkbox visually collapsed to 1px/opacity 0 (app.css:203), micro-targets (btn-xs 3px/9px padding 11px font app.css:253; 19px checkbox app.css:204; log tools), 10-12px type (app.css:149, 216, 289), muted #8a97a6-on-white for hints/headings (app.css:8, 191-193). Mitigations exist (:focus-visible outline app.css:53; role=dialog/aria-modal app.js:513,527; role=alert app.js:360,504; aria-live toasts index.html:45) but receipt failures are objective and plural.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport and layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass with target_invalid=false (measurement-summary.json:2,11-13,18); screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900 render consistently. However 4 receipt failures (a11y.contrast/focus_order/target_size, type.min_projected_size) imply a remediation pass before release — hence mid-scale, not clean.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 「不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径」 is implemented on both paths: S7/S8/S12 each carry confirmCode (GO-NEWDB/UNFREEZE-OK/RETIRE-OLD) plus a recovery block with window and steps (data.js:154-171, 184-201, 276-292); irreversible submit opens a confirmation modal showing consequence + recovery plan and requiring the typed code (app.js:512-525); post-execution recovery wizard with checklist + RECOVER code rolls the step back and re-locks successors (app.js:198-247); driver cases 3-7 exercise wrong-code interception, recovery open, and rollback end-to-end (source/_evidence-driver/driver.html:68-97). Warning triangles mark S7/S8/S12 in nav (screenshot left; app.js:336).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail (receipt check id): low-contrast muted palette used broadly — #8a97a6 on white for hints/section headings (css/app.css:8, 190-193), #9db1cc header subtext (app.css:71).

a11y.focus_order fail (receipt check id): modal focuses its input on open but has no focus trap and no focus restore on close (app.js:557-560, 611-614); full innerHTML re-render of nav/detail/inspector/log (app.js:423, 489, 501) can drop keyboard position.
a11y.target_size fail (receipt check id): micro controls — log 导出/复制 btn-xs (app.css:253), 19px custom checkbox box (app.css:204-205), compact nav rows.
type.min_projected_size fail (receipt check id): 10px badge (app.css:149), 11px monospace codes/timestamps (app.css:146, 294-296), 12px muted hints (app.css:40).

Guard intercept for clicking a locked step raises an error-styled banner+shake+toast for what a user may legitimately attempt (previewing a future step) (app.js:127-131, css/app.css:156-168) — intentional zero-mistake design but adds alarm friction; noted as observation, not scored.
missing_evidence: measurement-summary.json:7 records warnings:1 but no check in checks{} carries a warning state; the warned item cannot be attributed from the sanitized summary.

Receipt covers the initial page only; confirm/recovery modal and completion-screen behavior are evidenced by source + driver script (driver.html cases 3-8), not by screenshots, so modal-stage a11y/visuals at runtime are not directly observed.
scores.overall_note: impl-07 delivers a single 12-step, 4-phase cutover console whose representation matches the brief's consequential-flow shape almost exactly: wizard-enforced sequencing, one dominant execution card at load (both viewports), inline data with synchronous first render (app.js:617-621, satisfying the ready-on-load constraint), and — directly answering the acceptance seed — three irreversible steps (S7/S8/S12) each gated by a typed confirmation code and backed by an explicit recovery wizard with window countdown (data.js:154-292; app.js:512-545), with a driver that exercises wrong-code interception and full rollback. Structural scores are correspondingly high: zero navigation cost to the primary object, no context loss, and every permanent surface maps to a job need. The clear weakness is the accessibility/typography layer: 4 of 7 receipt checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) and the source corroborates the likely causes (hidden native checkboxes, 10-11px micro-type, modal focus management without trap/restore), while all layout checks pass and both screenshots show no visible defects. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; the high time_to_understand score is a model-judged proxy, not evidence of human preference.
